content.summary: Admin-facing pages for store management (/admin/stores) and user management (/admin/users). Admin can create stores, deactivate stores, create users with roles assigned, and deactivate users.

user_stories.want: to create a new store with its taxCode and address
user_stories.so_that: the store can onboard and cashiers can be assigned to it

user_stories.want: to create a user account with a specific role and store assignment
user_stories.so_that: staff can log in without needing developer access

user_stories.want: to deactivate a store or user
user_stories.so_that: I can remove access when staff leave or a store closes

business_rules: BR-ADMIN-01: Only admin role can access /admin/* routes
BR-ADMIN-02: taxCode is immutable after store creation (inherited from BR-STORE-03)
BR-ADMIN-03: Deactivating a user must flush their Redis sessions immediately
BR-ADMIN-04: User must be assigned a store unless role is admin
api_endpoints_used: GET    /auth/users        — list all users (admin only, NEEDS VERIFICATION)

tasks.title: Create user form (email, password, role, store)
Wire user pages to API + verify endpoints exist

audit.note: store-ui-user-ui feature created. Sprint 4 P2. Backend endpoints may need verification/addition.
